notes: D1 oracle is the official Osaka Metro EN routes / station list HAND-TRANSCRIBED (https://subway.osakametro.co.jp/en/station_guide/), confirmed against the official JP sister list and the 2025-04-04 路線図 PDF linked from the official route-map page. Stations arrays are official EN names in official code order. Not generated from GTFS. Not generated from Wikipedia, Transitland, Mobility Database, or ODPT.

City id osaka. Display Osaka. Agency Osaka Metro (大阪市高速電気軌道 / Osaka Municipal Subway). Not Tokyo Metro. Not a Keihanshin super-city. Do not invent city=osk, osaka-metro, kintetsu, japan, or merge into Tokyo.

City stays planned. Modes v1: subway / metro only — eight official subway lines. New Tram / Nanko Port Town (P09 Cosmosquare–P18 Suminoekoen) is printed as a ninth section on the official routes list and is OUT of v1. Imazato Liner BRT, Osaka City Bus, JR West, Hankyu, Hanshin, Nankai, Kintetsu, Keihan, Kita-Osaka Kyuko, Osaka Monorail, Hankai are out.

No official public GTFS or GTFS-RT. Transitland 0 hits. Mobility Database 0 Osaka Metro rows. Osaka Metro is not an ODPT member as of 1 Aug 2026. Do not invent an ODPT zip because Tokyo Metro has one. Live path is unverified HTML 列車走行位置 pages, not a product contract. No env key. adapterReady false.

Locked inner-city printed name: Hommachi / 本町 (M18 × Y13 × C16). Official transfers are Yotsubashi + Chuo only. Not Umeda, not Namba, not Shinsaibashi, not Sakaisuji-Hommachi, not Tennoji, not Downtown.

Through-run OUT: Kitakyu stations north of Esaka (Senri-Chuo / Momoyamadai / Minoh-Kayano) are not Metro-operated and have no M-codes. v1 is Metro-operated Midosuji M11–M30 only. Boarding PDF filename m_minohkayano.pdf is a trap, not a D1 terminus. Same: Hankyu mutual operation at K11; Kintetsu mutual operation at C23 Nagata.

Yumeshima (C09) is IN. Cosmosquare (C10) is a Chuo subway stop — New Tram P09 at the same place is out of v1. Suminoekoen (Y21) is a Yotsubashi subway terminus — New Tram P18 at the same place is out of v1.
